answer: A seat is admitted when sponsors lock umber into its inlet. The nebula links any seats sharing a sponsor, or whose sponsors ever traded umber, into one cluster. The k-th seat in a cluster opens its inlet only after k sponsors with no link to that cluster each lock 10 umber, all forfeited if two cluster seats co-sign a vote. A lone newcomer needs one sponsor and 10 umber. An operator's 20th clone needs 20 fresh unrelated sponsors, and 20 clones need 210 sponsors locking 2,100 umber, each a stranger who must be bribed to risk its stake.
